parsed.note: Changing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 only adjusts a freely-editable training hyperparameter (learning-rate warmup) and leaves TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' and the fixed eval on EVAL_SHARD=10 untouched, so val_bpb still measures real held-out model quality.
